purpose: Repair called run-support ownership and conditional inside obligations. No yardage or NFL average is an objective.
diagnosis: A lateral-position cutoff can exclude the actual curl-flat owner, promoting a deep defender to force even without disguise.
An explicit DE pass drop was excluded from support by slot-based first-level classification. Its run-front gap must still be reserved.
Promoting a box backer cannot erase an interior gap or steal the primary inserter's sole bubble. An explicit gap exchange also spends its backer before force selection.
repair: Select actual flat/curl-flat seats by their installed strength-relative side before grading presentation. Flat takes precedence over curl-flat; non-seat calls retain geometric fallback.
Keep deep/misaligned help from authorizing immediate spill. Preserve existing run-front contracts for converted man ends.
Reserve explicit dropper's run-front gap while making him eligible for outside support. Inside flow retains his boxed edge; he cannot spill to himself.

Allocate primary inside backers before conditional force backers, using remaining same-side bubbles only. Positive observed possession threatening the observed surface activates outside force; deep/unknown pictures retain insertion.
Reserve an explicit exchange backer; support allocation cannot silently cancel the installed edge/backer exchange.
scope: Selected run-support installation, not universal NFL Cover3 doctrine. Conditional free-fit landmarks retain the primary outside shoulder during pursuit and engagement; no complete contact-policy rewrite.
coachingBasis: docs/football-handbook/defense-and-perception.md: One defensive call spends eleven bodies; Run-support checks from the current film. Installed help differs from physically reachable help.

firstRequestWitness.meaning: At a deep observed mesh, conditional same-side C insertion replaces immediate outside widening. Requests are not instant motion.

withheldPrototypes.failure: Removing the dropping end's run-front claim makes FireL Sam take opposite-side C. At0.40s his strong-side force job requests lateral velocity -6.548yd/s across the box.
With the DE C claim restored, spatial ordering lets FireR Sam steal the only remaining A gap, duplicating Mike's default A job.

rediagnosis: Both allocation prototypes were withheld. A complete front/blitz/drop/inside ownership inventory, rather than extra force or movement adjustments, established the primary-before-conditional allocation rule.
remaining: Both explicit weak-exchange calls still fall back to deep FS for outside support. The caller needs an installed replacement/rotation; this patch does not invent one.
Six underneath safety/alley assignments remain unchanged; pass seat alone does not prove primary interior run duty.
No early outside-zone guard-flow anticipation, new pursuit capacities, complete tackling improvement, or empirical grip calibration.
Full games remain unrealistic; after-catch contact, deep coverage response and tackle approaches need diagnosis.
observationLimit: QB/RB pictures and cached keys are existing requested observations, not a causal sequence of exact controller reads. Retrospective two-case cached-surface context matches final signatures, but can overwrite earlier calls. Held-picture tests prove branch independence; cache geometry alone does not.

validation.fullSuiteTimingLimit: One complete run, with brief independent baseline reproduction; not an isolated speed benchmark.
validation.existingTestUpdates: Three assertions checked only edge labels. They now require both called outside force and retained boxed C on the same dropping end; 11v11, three/eight, marker, physical geometry and observer assertions remain strict.
